name: DW3 Mods
about: Mod index for the recompiled Digimon World 3 builds (SLES-03936 Europe, SLUS-01436 USA). Every package covers both builds unless its targets say otherwise.

mods.name: Warp / Teleport Tool (Fast Travel)
mods.summary: Open a destination list in the field and teleport to any of 239 field stages.
mods.controls: L2+R2 opens the list; D-pad moves, L1/R1 page, Cross warps, Triangle/Start exits.

mods.name: Save Anywhere
mods.summary: Open a Save Anywhere panel in the field with SELECT+SQUARE and save using the game's own memory-card screen.
mods.controls: SELECT+SQUARE opens the panel; D-pad picks SAVE GAME / CANCEL, Cross confirms, Triangle/Start exits. Confirming runs the game's own save screen.

mods.name: Enemy HP in battle
mods.summary: Draws the enemy's current and max HP on the battle HUD, on the free row under the enemy's HP bar.
mods.controls: None in game. Options: y (default 46) the HUD row, right (default 143) the right edge.

mods.name: Experience x1.2
mods.summary: Multiplies the EXP a battle awards by 1.2, applied at the reward table so the report, the bar and the level all agree.
mods.controls: None. Passive while enabled.

mods.name: Experience x1.5
mods.summary: Multiplies the EXP a battle awards by 1.5, applied at the reward table so the report, the bar and the level all agree.
mods.controls: None. Passive while enabled.

mods.name: Experience x2
mods.summary: Multiplies the EXP a battle awards by 2, applied at the reward table so the report, the bar and the level all agree.
mods.controls: None. Passive while enabled.

mods.name: Faster Dialogue Text (2x)
mods.summary: Reveals 2 characters per typewriter tick instead of 1: exactly 2x the dialogue text speed, with everything else timed normally.
mods.controls: None. Passive while enabled.

mods.name: Faster Dialogue Text (4x)
mods.summary: Reveals 4 characters per typewriter tick instead of 1: exactly 4x the dialogue text speed, with everything else timed normally.
mods.controls: None. Passive while enabled.

mods.name: Footstep volume 50%
mods.summary: Makes your own footstep sound half as loud. No other sound changes.
mods.controls: None. Passive while enabled.

mods.name: 60 Hz NTSC (Europe)
mods.summary: Runs the European (SLES-03936) build at NTSC timing and removes the 24-line PAL display offset. Data only, no rebuild. Europe only.
mods.controls: None. Passive while enabled.

disc_patch.name: Digimon World 3 (USA) modded disc patch
disc_patch.summary: A .bps patch that turns your own retail USA disc image into the finished six-mod image. Contains no game data and no disc image.
disc_patch.controls: None. Apply it to your own retail USA disc with FLIPS.
